title: BACKND Base cloud save
summary: Low-cost file/data storage via console-defined collections: list collections, upload, download, and delete. Optimized for cost, so it intentionally does not provide automatic data backup or detailed server request logs.
capabilities: route cloud-save storage questions to upload/download/delete/list flows
warn that cloud save lacks backup and request logging
recommend database or game-information for loss-sensitive or audited data
prerequisites: A collection is registered in the BACKND console
SDK is initialized and the user is logged in
common_pitfalls: Storing critical or loss-sensitive data in cloud save (no backup)
Expecting server-side request logs for troubleshooting
verification_required_for: exact method names and return objects
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route before generating upload/download code.
Confirm the no-backup/no-log policy and limits from the official page before recommending cloud save for important data.
public_notes: Cloud save is cost-optimized storage without backup or request logs.
Steer loss-sensitive data to database or game-information.
